title_zh: 邻居的“秘密”原来是惊喜派对
title_en: Funny Stories from Life (18/20): The Neighbors' "Secret" Was a Surprise Party
note_en: 原来 signals a sudden realization of how things really were, like "so it turns out" or "so that's why": 原来大家一直偷偷准备给她办一场惊喜派对 "It turned out everyone had been secretly planning a surprise party for her." English often needs a whole clause ("it turned out that..."), but Chinese just puts 原来 at the start of the sentence or before the verb.
